title: pstack per-target build config
description: Schema for a per-target plugin build config (for example .agents/plugins/pstack-build.json), matching what scripts/lib/targets.mjs loadTarget requires.

target.description: Target name; must equal the key this config is registered under.

displayName.description: Human-readable platform name used in validator messages.

sourceRoot.description: Canonical skill tree root, relative to the repository root.

outputRoot.description: Generated distribution root, relative to the repository root.

manifestSource.description: Hand-written manifest copied into the distribution.

manifestDestination.description: Manifest location inside the generated distribution.

referenceManifest.description: Manifest this target's version is compared against.

path.description: Marketplace file, relative to the repository root.

sourcePointer.description: Expected marketplace pointer at the generated distribution.

portabilityColumn.description: Portability column header name, or a zero-based column index.

runtimeMapping.description: Runtime mapping document, relative to sourceRoot.

stopPageTitle.description: Heading rendered on a generated unsupported-route stop page.

stopPageMappingLink.description: Link from a stop page back to the runtime mapping.

generatedBy.description: Generator recorded in the distribution's provenance file.

regenerateCommand.description: Command a maintainer runs to refresh the distribution.

manifestChecks.description: Named bundle of target-specific checks in the validator.

bannedVocabularies.description: Named vocabularies whose terms must not appear in generated skills.

forbiddenGeneratedDirectories.description: Directory names that must be absent from the generated distribution.

requiredSkills.description: Skill names the platform must discover.

requiredAgents.description: Agent names the platform must discover.

path.description: Resource replaced by a stop page, relative to the skills root.

reason.description: Sentence rendered on the stop page.

unsupportedResources.description: Routes replaced by generated stop pages.

runtimeResources.description: Script files packaged into the distribution, relative to the skills root.

source.description: File to copy, relative to sourceRoot.

destination.description: Destination inside the generated distribution; must land in a skill's references/ directory.

copiedSkillResources.description: Canonical files copied into a generated skill's references directory.

source.description: Canonical agent file to copy, relative to sourceRoot.

destination.description: Destination inside the generated distribution; must land in agents/.

name.description: Frontmatter name the copy is renamed to; must equal its file slug.

removeFrontmatter.description: Frontmatter keys dropped from the copy.

frontmatter.description: Frontmatter keys injected into, or overridden on, the copy.

copiedAgents.description: Canonical agents copied into the generated distribution's agents directory.

command.description: Platform CLI run against the generated tree when it is installed.

cliValidate.description: Optional platform CLI validation step, skipped when the CLI is absent.

path.description: Generated file the exception applies to, relative to outputRoot.

match.description: Exact matched text the scan may ignore in that file.

platformTermAllowlist.description: Reviewed exact-match exceptions to the platform-term scan.

relativePath.description: Normalized relative path that does not escape its root.
